text:
maria_ae: Quick heads up 1 Acme's procurement/legal asked for an evidence bundle for the POC: redacted SOC2 report, ISO control excerpts (encryption & ops), a signed pen-test attestation limited to staging, and a single-page POC runbook. They want a static CIDR for allowlisting and asked if we can pause dedicated billing during their audit window. Deadline: EOD Friday.

josh_se: Thanks. For the allowlist, we usually offer either a short-lived host list or a reserved CIDR. If they want static, we can allocate a /29 for the window. Which option do they prefer?

acme_ciso: Static /29 preferred. Also need the pen-test letter to explicitly state: "scope = staging only", the test dates, and a remediation contact. Is the template firm?

karim_security: We have an internal pen-test attestation template. Legal needs to sign; we can include the remediation contact (karim_security@redwood.ai). A /29 works operationally; we'll need to publish the exact IP range and firewall rules to eng-infra.

tara_compliance: SOC2 we can supply with standard redactions. ISO excerpt: we can pull the control descriptions for cryptography and change management into a 1-pager. I'll prepare both. For KMS specifics, we typically issue a short KMS addendum rather than include raw key material.

maria_ae: Can Evidence team upload the SOC2 redacted PDF to a presigned dropbox we can share with Acme? Also, Acme asked if signing the pen-test letter can be expedited to avoid delaying their start.

evidence_bot: Uploaded: /evidence/acme/1777777999/SOC2-2024-redacted.pdf (link valid 72h). Uploaded: /evidence/acme/1777777999/ISO-excerpts.zip (link valid 72h). :package:

josh_se: Re: billing pause 1 Operations can either issue a temporary credit for the POC period or convert the reserved capacity to burst-mode (lower committed units). Revenue Ops needs written terms: pause start/end, whether we keep reserved GPUs allocated, and the SLA changes. I'll spin up a RevOps ticket and tag @revops.

acme_ciso: Prefer a written credit so their finance team can reconcile. They do not need reserved GPUs during the audit but want the option to re-request identical capacity post-audit.

karim_security: If we release the reserved GPUs we should capture the re-provisioning lead time in writing. I'll include a note: "re-provisioning typical lead time = 48-72h" in the attestation addendum.

tara_compliance: Legal can sign the standard pen-test letter within 48 hours if they accept our template. If they request bespoke legal language, turnaround may be multi-business-day. Who's the Acme legal reviewer?

maria_ae: Acme legal contact is @acme_ciso (they're handling it for now). I'll ask if they accept standard wording.

josh_se: For the POC runbook I'll draft a one-page doc listing: allowlist CIDR, admin jump host, SSH key rotation, and support contact. Example snippet: 

```
POC runbook (excerpt):
ALLOWLIST: 198.51.100.0/29
ADMIN JUMP: 198.51.100.5
SUPPORT: infra-oncall@redwood.ai
NOTES: SSH keys expire after 7 days; provide key via secure presigned link.
```

karim_security: Small ask: please redact any internal hostnames or internal metrics from the SOC2 PDF before upload. We should also include a short note describing our KMS posture (HSM-backed keys, rotation every 90 days, role-based access).

evidence_bot: Confirmed: SOC2 redaction flag set; KMS addendum placeholder uploaded: /evidence/acme/1777777999/KMS-addendum-draft.pdf.

maria_ae: Action items: 1) Tara to route pen-test template to Legal for signature (48h) 2) Tara to prepare ISO excerpt + KMS addendum (EOD) 3) Karim to send final CIDR and firewall rule text to eng-infra (within 6h) 4) Josh to create RevOps ticket for temporary credit and capture terms. I'll tell Acme we will aim for Friday EOD delivery.

tara_compliance: Acknowledged. Posting pen-test template to #legal-review and will ping for expedited sign-off.

karim_security: I'll post firewall rule snippet in #eng-infra in 30m and include monitoring tags.

josh_se: RevOps ticket opened: ROPS-5421. Tagging @revops for approval on credit.

acme_ciso: Thank you. If we have the signed pen-test attestation and the static CIDR by Friday we can schedule our external testers for the following Monday. Please also state any SLA changes during the paused billing window in writing.

maria_ae: Will do. I'll include re-provisioning lead time and SLA impact in the credit terms. :thumbsup:
